name: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of PDQDeployRunner
description: Detects suspicious execution of "PDQDeployRunner" which is part of the PDQDeploy service stack that is responsible for executing commands and packages on a remote machines
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate use of the PDQDeploy tool to execute these commands
query: process.parent.executable:*\\PDQDeployRunner\-* AND ((process.executable:(*\\bash.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\csc.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\dllhost.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\scriptrunner.exe OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\wsl.exe)) OR (process.executable:(*\:\\ProgramData\\* OR *\:\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\TEMP\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp*)) OR (process.command_line:(*\ \-decode\ * OR *\ \-enc\ * OR *\ \-encodedcommand\ * OR *\ \-w\ hidden* OR *DownloadString* OR *FromBase64String* OR *http* OR *iex\ * OR *Invoke\-*)))
